field.name: yonkers_resident_rate
field.comment: Yonkers resident surcharge 16.75% of NY state tax (2025). New York Tax Law §1301. Yonkers is the only city in NY besides NYC with a local income tax. Calculated as percentage of state tax liability (not income). IT-201 Line 64. Source: NYS Tax Department, City of Yonkers

field.name: yonkers_nonresident_rate
field.comment: Yonkers non-resident wage tax 0.5% of wages (2025). New York Tax Law §1301. Applies to non-Yonkers residents who work in Yonkers. Separate from resident surcharge. IT-201 Line 65. Source: NYS Tax Department, City of Yonkers

field.name: ny_military_retirement_exclusion
field.comment: NY military retirement exclusion (computed - 100% exempt). New York Tax Law §612(c)(30). IT-201 Line 28 subtraction. New York provides full exclusion for US military retirement pay and SBP payments. No AGI limits. No age restrictions. One of most generous state military tax benefits. MOAA State Report Card 2025: Grade A. Honors MSRRA (spouse income exempt if different domicile) and SCRA (active duty pay exempt if different state of residence). Source: NYS Tax Department, MOAA

field.name: ny_subtractions
field.comment: NY state subtractions from federal AGI (computed). New York Tax Law §612. IT-201 Lines 20-34. Includes military retirement exclusion, pension exclusion (up to $20,000 for age 59.5+), college tuition credit, 529 plan subtraction, and other modifications. Source: NYS Tax Department
